key_insight: ViBMR introduces a large-scale brain MRI dataset paired with routine Vietnamese reports to support report-generation research in a low-resource clinical language.
clinical_relevance: This resource could support research toward reducing radiologists’ reporting workload, but clinical reliability is not established by the abstract.
method: Pair multi-sequence brain MRI with routine Vietnamese clinical reports.
Evaluate representative medical vision-language models for report generation.
Compare multi-sequence inputs and feature aggregation strategies.
evidence_signal: The dataset includes 3,649 patients and 11,875 MRI series across T1, T2, FLAIR, and contrast-enhanced T1; the abstract describes model evaluations but provides no quantitative performance results.
watch_item: Clinical deployment would require validation of report accuracy and generalizability beyond this dataset.
paper_title: ViBMR: A Large-Scale Multi-Sequence Brain MRI Dataset and Comprehensive Evaluation for Vietnamese Radiology Report Generation
